# The real binary creates a Git worktree and reports all five stable result lines.
exec zwm -C project wco feature/ready
cmpenv stdout result
! stderr .
exec realgit -C $ZWM_TEST_EXISTING_PATH symbolic-ref --short HEAD
stdout '^feature/ready\n$'
assert-log $ZWM_TEST_LOG want-log

-- result --
worktree_path=$ZWM_TEST_EXISTING_PATH
display_identity=feature/ready
tab_action=created
tab_title=project:feature/ready
tab_worktree=$ZWM_TEST_EXISTING_PATH
-- want-log --
